name: Starline T5 Track Busway 1200/1250 A
description: Largest Starline T5 overhead track busway: copper conductors in an extruded aluminium housing, 600 V AC or DC, 75 kAIC, UL 857 / IEC 61439. Plug-in units interchangeable across T5 sizes.

capacity_w.note: 1200 A x 415 V x sqrt(3) = 862.6 kW at 415 V 3-phase, unity pf, 100% rated busway. At 480 V: 997.7 kW. 1250 A IEC rating gives 898.5 kW at 415 V

voltage_v.note: assumed 415 V 3-phase AI-row distribution; busway rated voltage is 600 V AC or DC

weight_kg_per_m.note: brochure: 21 lb (9.53 kg) per 1 ft (0.3048 m) straight section, 4-pole

sources.title: Legrand Starline Track Busway Mission Critical Brochure (2025)
